consumer: An engine condition/dialogue possession check (conditional_t::set_has_items, the u_has_items predicate) asking 'does the character currently possess 1st_aid on their person?'
scope: only the character's own on-person carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), NOT items merely reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, the engine-computed possession verdict
divergence: A 1st_aid kit lying on the tile under or adjacent to the player (or in a nearby reachable container) but not held: the engine possession predicate returns false, while a re-derivation over reachable/nearby inventory or a carried-items display panel would wrongly answer 'holding = yes'
